# Verification Activity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:VerificationActivity`](gmeow-VerificationActivity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/VerificationActivity>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An activity that checks a signature, attestation, artifact, or ledger inclusion proof — performed by a verifier agent or software. The outcome is a [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](gmeow-VerificationResult.md), not a global truth assertion.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:VerificationActivity`](gmeow-VerificationActivity.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to model the ACT of checking an attestation, signature, or inclusion proof — the event a verifier (agent or software) performs — when you need the checking process with its inputs, agent, and time as a first-class occurrent.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the categorical outcome of the check (that is [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](gmeow-VerificationResult.md) / [`gmeow:VerificationStatus`](gmeow-VerificationStatus.md)) and for the vouching act being checked ([`gmeow:Attestation`](gmeow-Attestation.md)); the activity is the checking, not the verdict or the thing checked.

### How to use

- Mint the activity, link it from the [`Attestation`](gmeow-Attestation.md) with [`gmeow:verificationActivity`](../properties/gmeow-verificationActivity.md), attribute it to a verifier with [`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](../properties/gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md), and let it produce a [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](gmeow-VerificationResult.md); the cryptographic and policy checks themselves run in the solver layer ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### Examples

- ex:verifyRun a [`gmeow:VerificationActivity`](gmeow-VerificationActivity.md); [`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](../properties/gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md) ex:ciVerifier.
